# 3D Sudoku / 스도쿠 3D / 3D数独

> A tactile 3D sudoku played on a warm wooden board with ceramic number tiles: drag a tile onto a cell or select a cell and tap a number. Five rated difficulty levels, notes, undo/redo and answer checking. No login, no account, no server storage — only the language preference is remembered on this device.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://sudoku.try-dabble.com/
The only thing this app writes to the browser is the chosen UI language (localStorage key sudoku_lang, plus a td_lang cookie shared across try-dabble.com subdomains). A puzzle in progress lives only in page memory: closing or reloading the tab starts a fresh game. No accounts, no subscription, no server-side storage, no sharing.

This is NOT a competitive or timed sudoku app and NOT a puzzle archive with saved history. There is no leaderboard, no streak tracker and no cloud save. It is a single wooden board on a desk: pick a difficulty, place the tiles, done.

- [Home](https://sudoku.try-dabble.com/): The board — choose a size and difficulty, then play

## How it plays

- Two board sizes: 6×6 (each row, column and 2×3 box holds 1–6 once) and 9×9 (each row, column and 3×3 box holds 1–9 once)
- Five rated difficulty levels: beginner, easy, medium, hard, expert
- Place a digit by dragging a ceramic tile onto a cell, or by selecting a cell and tapping a number
- Notes mode for pencilling in candidates before committing to a digit
- Undo and redo, erase, and an answer-checking mode that flags conflicts
- Fixed clue digits cannot be changed
- Works with a finger, a mouse, or Apple Pencil — no input method is required

## Features

- Rendered as a real 3D scene (three.js): the board tilts, tiles have depth and drop into place
- Optional background music and sound effects, each with its own volume; music is not downloaded until turned on
- Optional haptics and a reduced-motion setting
- Timer, per-digit usage counts, and an accessible board with keyboard and screen-reader labels
- No login, no sign-up, no payment screen, no ads-for-progress gate
- No daily puzzle limit and no premium tier: every size and difficulty is always open
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
